result:
All 68 tests pass, full suite green. Summary of the changes:

- `bin/cli.js`: extracted the shared load-and-build-invoice logic (file read, JSON parse, `buildInvoice`, and the existing error handling) into `loadInvoice`, then added a `--summary <order-file>...` mode that reuses it — printing one `SUMMARY <id> total=<total>` line per order as each is processed (so earlier successes remain on stdout if a later file fails) plus a final `SUMMARY TOTAL orders=<n> net=<net>` line, using the existing `money`/rounding module.
- `test/cli.test.js`: added cases for the worked example (`order-b.json` + `order-c.json` → net 70.52), the unknown-discount-code failure mid-run (exit 2, prior line preserved, exact stderr), a missing order file (exit 1), and no order files given (exit 1).
